description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Though called a wax candy ear, this "treat" isn't made from traditional candy wax, but instead from the earwax of local giants. It's then formed into the shape of an ear and decorated with fancy powders to appear more appetizing. Upon eating a wax candy ear, you become immune to spells and actions with the auditory trait for 5 minutes as a casing of wax forms over your ears. Once the effects have worn off, you can remove the casing from your ears and consume it as well (with 2 Interact actions); however, this has no effect and is very gross.
